Source: [4392](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4392); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Loop If Condition Is True](../../api/actions/loop-if-condition-is-true.md).
